Each entry must be verified by building the widget in Elementor and exporting it — never added by guessing. Provenance is recorded per entry.

container._why: Real container controls the mined kits never exercised. Sticky is Pro's motion-effects section, registered on containers at runtime rather than in the widget definition the scraper reads; `hide` and the responsive-visibility keys come from the same place.
container.verified_slideshow: Read from source, 2026-10-26 (Lakes Construction build): Elementor 4.2.4 includes/elements/container.php:668 registers the 'background' group with types classic/gradient/video/slideshow, and includes/controls/groups/background.php defines the slideshow_* fields listed. Prefixed with the group name 'background_'. Not yet confirmed by a live export - do that on the next live import.

posts._why: The `posts` widget registers its controls per skin, so the PHP scrape that built elementor-registry.json only captured the skin-agnostic base. Without these every styled Posts widget fails V6, and the untyped fallback renders in Elementor's default card styling rather than the kit's.
posts.verified: Mined from the shipped Scoop – News & Magazine kit (scoop-news-magazine-...-utc.zip): 32 `posts` widgets, 5 on the cards skin and 27 on classic. Every key below appears in a real exported settings or __globals__ object in that file.
